name: effort-router
description: Decides the session's reasoning effort once the task is clear (a Haiku read of the transcript against Anthropic's 'Spending your effort' guidance and your own rules), asks you to confirm, then holds it for every request and subagent. The footer shows the state (deciding, fixed, off) and is a dropdown to accept, decide again or turn the router off; for a specific level, turn it off and use the effort picker.

consent.title: Consent before locking
consent.description: "band" (default): offer the level with buttons above the prompt and lock on a click. "ask": a blocking question before the turn runs. "none": lock without asking.

snoozePrompts.title: Not-now snooze (prompts)
snoozePrompts.description: After "Not now", how many of your prompts pass before the router reads the transcript again.

maxReads.title: Classifier reads per session
maxReads.description: Most transcript reads while undecided; after that the picker's effort stands until /route auto.

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: Alias or id of the model that reads the transcript.

syncPicker.title: Sync the effort picker
syncPicker.description: Run /effort <level> when a level is fixed so the terminal's picker label matches (its echo also tells the model). The Desktop picker is app-owned and does not move.

rules.title: Routing rules
rules.description: Extra routing rules in plain words. Include a line that is exactly $defaults to keep the rules beneath (shipped defaults, then your organisation's); without it these rules replace them. A ~/.claude/effort-router.md file takes precedence over this option.

footerControl.title: Footer control
footerControl.description: "select" (default): the footer label is a dropdown of the router's choices. "label": plain text only; use /route to change the state.
